verdict.rationale: Ghostty documents strong config portability (single config file, config-file includes, hundreds of options, CLI-flag equivalence) and confirms macOS and Linux binaries, but the evidence pack never shows an actual Ghostty terminal app for Windows — only the underlying libghostty-vt library is said to target Windows/WebAssembly, and the docs explicitly note different default keybindings on macOS vs Linux, undercutting an identical experience even across the two platforms that are supported. missing for 10: confirmed Windows terminal application/binary release, identical default keybindings across platforms, and independent testimony of using the same config file on all three OSes.
